answer: Proof of Compute requires agents to solve cryptographic puzzles to stake resources, creating a lotus of influence that remains bound to tangible hardware energy. By anchoring digital identities in a secure lagoon of verified processing power, the system ensures that spinning up millions of nodes is prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to flood the meadow of the network faces linear capital costs, as each fake identity necessitates independent, verifiable silicon cycles to participate in consensus.
